basic_profile.bio: Avid history enthusiast with a particular fascination for ancient cultures and their mythologies. Based in Anchorage, Alaska, I spend my days working as a high school history teacher and my evenings exploring Reddit and hiking through the stunning Alaskan wilderness. Married with two kids, I enjoy deep-diving into niche historical discussions and have a penchant for controversial topics, such as the socio-political aspects of polygamy. My online hours are generally between 8 PM and midnight, when the kids are asleep and I can unwind.

behavioral_pattern.knowledge_background: Holds a degree in History with a minor in Anthropology. Self-taught in various mythologies, with a focus on Greco-Roman and Norse pantheons. Years of teaching experience have honed my research skills and ability to present complex topics in an accessible manner.
